title: BBC Three and BBC Scotland TV channels to be shut down next year
summary_full: Corporation announces broadcast closures and job losses in effort to find savings of £500mUK politics live – latest updatesTelevision channels BBC Three and BBC Scotland are to close and the Radio 4 Extra radio station will be scrapped, as part of the corporation’s continuing drive to cut £500m in costs.Both TV channels are to move online as executives attempt to plug a funding crisis and adapt the broadcaster’s output for audiences that increasingly watch content on demand. All three outlets will close in the spring. Continue reading...
